title: Match Arm Compatibility
goal: Return a score for each signal level, keeping all match arms on the same type.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Morning: Control Flow Basics

hints: Every arm in a match expression must evaluate to the same type.
A block ending with a semicolon yields the unit type (), not the number before it.
explanation: `match` is an expression that produces a value. Every arm in a `match` must evaluate to the exact same type. Ending a block with a semicolon like `{ 0; }` yields `()` instead of `i32`. This causes error `E0308` because the arms have incompatible types. Placing a semicolon after the `match` turns the expression into a statement returning `()`, which breaks the function return type.
